{{Quote|My name is Raxa Binn. I train commandos here at Zephyr Base as well as wreak a little havoc on the Imperials when time permits. If you want to get on my good side you should do a little work for me. You could pick up a few credits and help the Alliance at the same time. Interested?|Raxa Binn, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Raxa Binn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Teacher/Legends|trainer]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Stationed at [[Zephyr Base]], a hidden Alliance outpost on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], Binn was responsible for preparing Rebel operatives and leading strikes against nearby [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Exhibiting uncompromising leadership and a strict focus on operational security, she directed missions aimed at protecting the secrecy of Zephyr Base and disrupting Imperial patrols in the surrounding wilderness.

==Biography==
===Zephyr Base trainer===
[[File:BootoLubble.png|thumb|150px|Gungan liaison Booto Lubble expressed a deep fondness for Raxa Binn.]]
{{Quote|My be sweetin' on de commando trainer here, Raxa Binn. Shesa mooie-mooie! My tinkin' shesa likin' a necklace made of Empire rank cylinder tings.|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="Lubble">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Booto Lubble|Rori}}</ref>}}
Raxa Binn was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who was present at [[Zephyr Base]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]<ref name="AED" /> by around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> There she served as a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Teacher/Legends|trainer]] who split her [[Time/Legends|time]] between preparing operatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and striking at nearby [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrols during the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

At Zephyr Base, Binn intersected with the work of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] liaison [[Booto Lubble]], who openly admired her and believed a gift would win her favor.<ref name="Lubble" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Lubble organized two retrieval operations intended to furnish a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] for Binn. The first component was the [[Code cylinder/Legends|rank cylinder]] of [[Warrant Officer/Legends|Warrant Officer]] [[Luhin Jinnor]], which Lubble specifically requested because its hue matched the [[Color/Legends|color]] of Binn’s [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Lubble also recounted overhearing Binn remark that “every time I see that Gungan, I want a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]],” a cutting line he nonetheless interpreted as inspiration for a gift pendant. He therefore sought<ref name="Lubble" /> a [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Class-A thermal detonator/Legends|Class-A thermal detonator]]<ref name="Detonator">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Imperial Army Thermal Detonator}}</ref> carried by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rohd Gostervek]] to complete the necklace. Each item was taken from personnel in [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Zarvold|Zarvold’s]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] on Rori. Lubble also claimed that Binn despised Zarvold, though he did not know the reason.<ref name="Lubble" />

===Eliminating the squad leader===
[[File:KilltheStormtrooperLeader.jpg|thumb|Alliance operatives cut down the stormtrooper squad leader and his patrol near Zephyr Base.]]
{{Quote|There is a group of Imperial stormtroopers that have been getting a little too close to this outpost for my liking. Their leader is a stormtrooper squad leader. I think he's the one who suspects something is going on. Next time he's on patrol, take him out. He'll have friends with him, so bring some people you can trust.|Raxa Binn, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
One of Binn’s assignments from Zephyr Base involved the elimination of an Imperial [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper squad leader]] who had begun patrolling dangerously close to the outpost. Believing the [[Commander/Legends|officer]] to be suspicious of Alliance activity in the area, she urged a Rebel-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to intercept and [[Death/Legends|kill]] him before the location of the base was compromised. The squad leader was accompanied by fellow [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]],<ref name="AED" /> up to three in total,<ref name="KillTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Kill the Stormtrooper Leader}}</ref> requiring a careful and coordinated attack. Binn suggested bringing along trusted friends for the attack, which culminated in violent [[Lightfight|firefight]] between the Imperial and Rebel forces. Upon the squad leader’s death, Binn expressed satisfaction with the outcome with a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] reward, and suggested she might have further tasks for the operative.<ref name="AED" />

===Rescuing the Rebel Scout===
[[File:RescuetheScout.jpg|thumb|The overdue Rebel scout, detained by Imperial forces]]
{{Quote|One of the outpost's scouts is overdue to check in and some stormtrooper commandos have been spotted in the vicinity of that patrol area. We think they may have captured our scout. Would you be willing to go handle the rescue?|Raxa Binn, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Following the elimination of the stormtrooper squad leader, Raxa Binn assigned a more delicate task. One of Zephyr Base’s [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] had failed to report back, and Imperial [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] had been sighted near the patrol route. Binn feared the missing<ref name="AED" /> male [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ScoutTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Rescue the Scout}}</ref> scout had been captured and warned that the storm commandos were among the Empire’s best-trained and best-equipped [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. She urged the operative to carry heavy firepower and to bring along trusted allies.<ref name="AED" />

The scout had indeed been detained by Imperial forces, guarded closely by two stormtroopers.<ref name="ScoutTCG" /> Yet by the time Rebel operatives set out to find the scout, the captive had slipped free of confinement and fled into the Rori wilderness. When finally located, the shaken scout initially mistook the rescuers for Imperial lackeys before recognizing their allegiance.<ref name="AED" />

Escorted back to Zephyr Base without further resistance, the scout was safely reunited with Alliance forces. Binn praised the successful recovery, reassured that the secrecy of the outpost had been preserved, and told her operative that the mission proved they had the makings of a fine commando. She also provided a credit payout in recognition of their service.<ref name="AED" />

===Assault on the Imperial mobile base===
[[File:DestroytheImperialBase.jpg|thumb|Rebel operatives destroy the Imperial mobile base.]]
{{Quote|I had some of our scouts check out why there's been so much action here recently. Those commandos were part of a larger mobile force looking for Alliance activity. I need someone who's willing to go and take out this mobile base. Are you interested or is it too much for you?"<br />"Won't it attract a lot of attention if they all go missing?"<br />"Not nearly so much as if they find this outpost. We can always relocate to keep them off our track once you've taken care of their base. Are you up to this or not?"<br />"Yes."<br />"You have two objectives: First, take out that base; second, leave no survivors. This isn't going to be easy. Get your team together and leave immediately. Good luck.|Raxa Binn and a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Following the successful rescue of the captured scout, Raxa Binn escalated her campaign against the Imperial presence on Rori. Reconnaissance by her scouts revealed that the stormtrooper commandos previously encountered were only the vanguard of a much larger Imperial mobile force sweeping the region in search of Alliance activity. Determined to protect Zephyr Base from discovery, Binn ordered her operative to assemble a team, locate the enemy’s mobile base, and destroy it completely before it could threaten the outpost.<ref name="AED" />

Binn issued explicit instructions: the base was to be completely eliminated, and no Imperial survivors were to be left behind, lest they report the existence of Zephyr Base. She warned the operative of the difficulty of the mission and urged them to bring reliable backup.<ref name="AED" />

The team ultimately confronted a contingent of four storm commandos, engaging them in a fierce firefight before<ref name="AED" /> demolishing the Imperial base.<ref name="DestroyTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Destroy the Imperial Base}}</ref> In the fiery aftermath, one stormtrooper surrendered, raising their arms in a plea for mercy. However, Binn’s orders had been clear: leave no survivors. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper’s]] fate was sealed as one of the Rebels leveled their [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]] at the unarmed Imperial.<ref name="NoSurvivorsTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Leave No Survivors}}</ref>
[[File:LeaveNoSurvivors.jpg|thumb|Raxa Binn's orders were clear: leave no survivors.]]
Upon returning to Zephyr Base, Binn praised the success of the operation and once again provided a credit reward. She remarked that with more [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of such skill, she could drive the Imperials off Rori entirely. The destruction of the mobile base secured the secrecy of the Alliance outpost and delivered a major blow to local Imperial operations. Still, Binn cautioned that the Rebels would need to lay low for a time to avoid drawing further Imperial attention, but hinted that more opportunities to strike back would come in the future.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}
==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ooah, de rank cylinder tings for warrant officers bein' just de right color for matchin' Raxa Binn's eyes!|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="Lubble" />}}
Raxa Binn was a fair-skinned female Zabrak with blue eyes, brown hair, and gray facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]].<ref name="AED" /> As a dedicated commando trainer at Zephyr Base, she balanced her time between preparing operatives of the Rebel Alliance and personally leading strikes against Imperial forces. Binn demonstrated a practical and direct demeanor, issuing her instructions with confidence and clarity. She was unflinching in the face of Imperial threats, describing missions in blunt, sometimes severe terms and emphasizing the importance of secrecy for the survival of the outpost.<ref name="AED" />

Her dialogue reflected a results-driven mindset. Binn had little patience for hesitation, openly criticizing those who lacked the resolve or strength to complete difficult tasks. When assigning dangerous operations, such as the destruction of the Imperial mobile base, she insisted on reliable allies and proper preparation, warning of the risks involved. Despite her stern approach, she acknowledged and rewarded success, praising skilled operatives and expressing that, with more soldiers of similar caliber, she could drive the Imperials from Rori entirely.<ref name="AED" />

Binn’s focus on operational security was evident in her orders to leave no Imperial survivors during high-stakes missions. She viewed the elimination of threats as essential to safeguarding Zephyr Base, even if such actions required harsh measures. While she occasionally encouraged operatives by offering credits and personal commendations, her priority was always the protection of her people and the continuation of the Alliance’s presence on Rori.<ref name="AED" />

Binn’s reputation among allies included more personal impressions. The Gungan liaison Booto Lubble spoke admiringly of her and undertook the creation of a necklace assembled from captured Imperial equipment as a gift. Binn’s feelings toward Lubble were not reciprocated. As related by Lubble, she once quipped that every time she saw him she wanted a thermal detonator&mdash;a joke he took literally when commissioning a detonator as the necklace’s pendant. In the same exchanges, Lubble stated that Binn hated Colonel Zarvold, although he did not know why.<ref name="Lubble" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|There are always more Imperials that need to die.|Raxa Binn, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Raxa Binn wore an assortment of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with multiple color tones. Her suit included a green [[Padded armor/Legends|padded armor]] chestplate and matching padded armor leggings, each contrasted against a blue underlay. For additional defense, she wore a pair of [[marine armor]] biceps, [[Silver/Legends|silver]] in appearance, which added extra protection to her upper arms. Completing her set were [[composite armor]] [[Bracer/Legends|bracers]] and composite armor [[Boot/Legends|boots]], both also silver.<ref name="AED" /> She also possessed light Rebel [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]].<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I wish they'd stop sending me people who were all talk and no action.|Raxa Binn, to players who refused to rescue the Rebel scout|<ref name="AED" />}}
Raxa Binn was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

She was located at Zephyr Base on Rori, where she provided a series of three quests to Rebel-aligned players. These quests focused on safeguarding the outpost and disrupting local Imperial operations. The first quest involved eliminating an Imperial stormtrooper squad leader accompanied by two stormtrooper escorts before they could compromise the location of Zephyr Base. The second tasked players with rescuing a captured Rebel scout, though despite the quest dialogue suggesting otherwise, no enemies were actually encountered during the rescue. The final quest escalated the conflict, with players ordered to assault and destroy a mobile Imperial base comprising four storm commandos.<ref name="AED" />

Each quest rewarded players with credits and Rebel faction points. While the quests were possible for solo players, Binn’s dialogue strongly encouraged the formation of a team, so this article assumes that a group of operatives carried out the missions.<ref name="AED" />

The total rewards for completing Binn’s questline included 100 credits and 200 Rebel faction points for the strike on the stormtrooper patrol, 100 credits and 200 Rebel faction points for the rescue mission, and 200 credits and 200 Rebel faction points for the destruction of the Imperial mobile base.<ref name="AED" />

Binn also featured in the storyline of Booto Lubble, another non-player character at Zephyr Base. Lubble’s quests centered on his attempts to win her affection by commissioning a necklace made from captured Imperial equipment.<ref name="Lubble" />

Beyond the game, Binn’s quests were represented in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' through the [[2010]] ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' expansion. Several cards, such as ''Kill the Stormtrooper Leader'', ''Rescue the Scout'', ''Destroy the Imperial Base'', and ''Leave No Survivors'', featured original artwork inspired by the events of her questline, providing an expanded visual depiction of the conflict around Zephyr Base.<ref name="KillTCG" /><ref name="ScoutTCG" /><ref name="DestroyTCG" /><ref name="NoSurvivorsTCG" />
